description: This file defines a namespace with classes and templates for parsing text, including a generic ParserType template, TextParser, and PathParser, along with associated methods and enums for handling parsing states, text extraction, and path components.

classes.name: ParserType
classes.description: A template class for parsing text streams with customizable terminator and handler, managing parsing states, buffer, and processing logic.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class for parsing text fragments, reading numbers, enumerations, key-value pairs, ranges, and performing text validation and navigation.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class for parsing file paths into drive, path, filename, basename, and extension components.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the parser state to initial conditions.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Returns the current byte position in the stream.

methods.name: CollectWord
methods.description: Configures the parser to collect a word, optionally with a split character and case state.

methods.name: CollectLine
methods.description: Configures the parser to collect a line, with optional case state.

methods.name: FlushLine
methods.description: Sets the parser to flush the current line.

methods.name: PassThrough
methods.description: Configures the parser to pass through a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into parser state, handling pass-through, line flushing, whitespace skipping, and token parsing.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads text from a fragment until delimiters are encountered.

methods.name: ReadNumber
methods.description: Reads a number of specified type from the text fragment.

methods.name: ReadEnumerate
methods.description: Reads an enumeration value from the text fragment.

methods.name: ReadKeyValuePair
methods.description: Reads a key-value pair separated by a specified divider.

methods.name: ReadRange
methods.description: Reads a range of numbers from the text fragment.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips a specified number of positions.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds specified characters in the text fragment.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the text fragment against a comparison, case-sensitive or insensitive.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a path string into drive, path, filename, basename, and extension components.
